description: Accessibility requirements for compiled React components

rules.description: Interactive elements (onClick, onKeyDown) must have explicit role or use semantic HTML
rules.check: div[onClick] must have role=button or be wrapped in <button>
button with no text content must have aria-label or aria-labelledby

rules.description: Elements with onClick must also handle onKeyDown (Enter/Space)
rules.check: onClick presence implies onKeyDown or use of <button>

rules.description: Focusable elements must not have outline:none without a visible focus alternative
rules.check: absence of outline: none or outline: 0 without focus-visible alternative

rules.description: Text color must have ≥4.5:1 contrast ratio against background (WCAG AA)
rules.check: design tokens must define contrast-safe pairs

rules.description: axe-core must report zero violations on all rendered variants
Page-level components must use landmark roles (main, nav, aside, etc.)
All img elements must have non-empty alt text (or alt='' for decorative)
